esignature.law_en: Electronic Commerce Law 1382 (WIPO Lex: Electronic Commerce Act 2003). Art. 2 defines a secure (enhanced/advanced) electronic signature as one complying with art. 10 (unique to the signatory, identifies the signatory, made by or under the sole intention of the signatory, affixed so that any change to the data message can be detected). Art. 14: data messages generated and stored by a secure method are deemed valid and reliable documents by judicial and legal authorities. Art. 15: the validity of a secure data message, record or signature may not be denied; only a claim of forgery or of invalidity on legal grounds may be raised (per WIPO Lex English translation).
